messages:
Marta R.: Heads-up: ran int8 bring-up for reranker-3B on ap-southeast and eu-west. Throughput looks okay but tail latency spikes in ap-southeast on GPU nodes. TL;DR: throughput ~480 qps vs ~520 in eu-west; p95 58ms vs 34ms; p99 210ms vs 72ms. Anyone seen PCIe/NUMA churn cause this? :eyes:

Kai Z.: Which node SKU and bench command did you run? Also which kernel was selected?

Marta R.: Ran on g4dnx-48gb (ap-southeast-1), command below:
```
./bench --model reranker-3b --quant int8 --batch 8 --dims 768 --node g4dnx-48gb --region ap-southeast-1 --kernel auto --threads 8 --warmup 200 --qps 500
```
Quick CSV excerpt from the run:
```
region,p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,avg_qps
eu-west-1,18,34,72,520
ap-southeast-1,22,58,210,480
```

Jason L.: Is this dedicated capacity or shared? NUMA effects on these SKUs can show up as long tails if some processes steal the PCIe bandwidth.

Marta R.: Dedicated. SRE checked co-tenancy low. I dug into NVML counters — saw occasional PCIe link resets around the p99 windows. Sample log line: `nvml pcie rx err 2 at 2026-03-18T14:02:11Z stack:gpu0`

Anika P.: Could also be kernel selection for int8. `--kernel auto` can pick a safe fallback path which is memory-heavy for some dims. For int8 we have two primary fwd kernels: `quant_fast` (lower tail on many GPUs) and `fallback` (more robust but higher throughput). Try pinning `--kernel quant_fast` and re-run.

Kai Z.: Reran with `--kernel quant_fast` in ap-southeast-1 (same node), batch 8. Results: p50 20ms, p95 40ms, p99 90ms, avg_qps 430. So p99 improved massively but throughput dropped ~10%. :thinking:

Marta R.: Interesting — tradeoff looks like tail vs throughput. Ops suggestion: do a canary rollout that pins `quant_fast` for 10% of rerank traffic in ap-southeast and route high-concurrency customers to eu-west until infra ticket resolved. I'll open a ticket for the PCIe resets and schedule a 24h canary.

InfraBot: Ticket INF-2284 created: Investigate PCIe link resets on ap-southeast g4dnx-48gb nodes. Assigned to @Jason L.

Marta R.: Thanks @Jason. Canary plan: pin kernel to `quant_fast`, batch=8, canary weight=10%, start 13:00 UTC. Bench artifacts and raw traces uploaded: gs://redwood-bench/1849123456-apac-int8/ . I'll share perf counters after 12h.
